title: Charge, state and structure are recovered under different conditions

statements.text: Continuity and measured boundary flux recover an integrated charge. Recovering a whole earlier state also needs injective evolution and complete later data, and recovering structure needs a declared identifying observable map.

sources.quote: Charge recovery requires only continuity and measured boundary flux. Structural recovery is not claimed without an identifying observable map.
Earlier ideal states can be reconstructed from complete later states on a periodic domain
